title: HTTP layer uses Cowboy 1.x API against declared cowboy 2.10.0 — no endpoint serves at runtime
evidence: src/book_api_routes.erl:19 -behaviour(cowboy_http_handler) (absent in 2.x); :44 init/2 returns 2-tuple {ok,#{}} but 2.x requires {ok,Req,State}; :47 handle/2 never called by 2.x; :64,97 cowboy_req:body/1 and :81 cowboy_req:query_params/1 undefined in 2.x. rebar.config:2 = {cowboy,"2.10.0"}. grep src/ for read_body/reply/parse_qs/cowboy_handler = NONE. Compiles but crashes per request.
suggestion: Rewrite as a Cowboy 2.x cowboy_handler: init(Req,State) that reads body via cowboy_req:read_body/1, parses qs via cowboy_req:parse_qs/1, and calls cowboy_req:reply/4 with {ok,Req,State}.

title: No HTTP status codes set — 201/400/404 absent, all differentiation is in JSON body
evidence: src/book_api_routes.erl:47-55 handle/2 only calls cowboy_req:set_resp_header/3 + set_resp_body/2, never cowboy_req:reply/4. create/duplicate/validation-error/not_found all return the same status; error info lives only in the JSON body. grep of src/ for reply/status/201/404/400 finds only JSON body fields and gen_server {reply,...} tuples.
suggestion: Use cowboy_req:reply(201,...) on create, 400 on validation failure, 404 on not_found, 200 otherwise.

title: ?author= filter never fires
evidence: src/book_api_routes.erl:81 calls undefined cowboy_req:query_params/1; even if it returned a proplist, keys would be binaries while book_api_db:get_books/1 (src/book_api_db.erl:77) matches atom key `author` in #{author := Author}.
suggestion: Read qs with cowboy_req:parse_qs/1 and match on the binary key <<"author">>.

title: Validation does not return 400 and is unreachable at runtime
evidence: src/book_api_routes.erl:130 validate_book_params/1 correctly requires title+author and is unit-tested, but errors are returned as a JSON body (no 400 status), and the POST path that invokes it never runs (see R8-http).
suggestion: Return 400 on {error,_} from validation once the handler runs under Cowboy 2.x.

title: POST /books non-functional at runtime
evidence: Route src/book_api_routes.erl:63 + book_api_db:create_book/1 src/book_api_db.erl:69,97 exist and are correct, but the handler never executes under Cowboy 2.x (R8-http); untested.
suggestion: Fix the Cowboy 2.x handler so the create path runs; add an integration test.

title: GET /books/{id} non-functional; no 404 status
evidence: Route src/book_api_routes.erl:87 maps {error,not_found} to a JSON body only (:91) with no 404 status, and the handler does not run at runtime (R8-http).
suggestion: Reply 404 on not_found once the handler runs.

title: Tests exercise a copy of validation, not the shipped modules
evidence: test/book_api_unit_tests.erl:42-50 defines a local copy of validate_book_params/1 and tests that; no test imports book_api_routes or book_api_db. Agent stdout admits an unresolved eunit-discovery problem. test_coverage=1.0 but no system module is actually covered.
suggestion: Test the real modules and add HTTP-level integration tests.
